easy: Seeing something, especially something unusual.

ex.en: There was a sighting of a whale near the beach.
ex.ko: 해변 근처에서 고래가 목격되었다.

easy: A machine that uses sound waves to find things underwater.

ex.en: The ship used sonar to find the sunken boat.
ex.ko: 배는 소나로 가라앉은 보트를 찾았다.

easy: Making something steady so it doesn't change or shake.

ex.en: The stabilization of prices helped the farmers.
ex.ko: 물가 안정화는 농부들에게 도움이 되었다.

easy: Making a boat or plane steady so it won't tip over.

ex.en: The stabilization of the boat kept it from rocking.
ex.ko: 배의 안정화 장치 덕분에 배가 흔들리지 않았다.

easy: A white food powder found in potatoes, rice, and corn.

ex.en: Potatoes are full of starch.
ex.ko: 감자에는 녹말이 가득하다.

easy: A powder or spray that makes clothes stiff after washing.

ex.en: Dad used starch to make his shirt stiff.
ex.ko: 아빠는 셔츠를 빳빳하게 하려고 풀을 쓰셨다.

easy: In a gentle way that is hard to notice.

ex.en: The colors changed subtly from blue to green.
ex.ko: 색이 파랑에서 초록으로 미묘하게 변했다.

easy: A person who rides waves on a board.

ex.en: The surfer rode a big wave to the shore.
ex.ko: 서퍼가 큰 파도를 타고 해변까지 왔다.

easy: The amount that one small spoon can hold.

ex.en: Add one teaspoon of sugar to the tea.
ex.ko: 차에 설탕 한 티스푼을 넣어라.

easy: A small spoon for stirring drinks.

ex.en: I stirred my hot chocolate with a teaspoon.
ex.ko: 나는 티스푼으로 핫초코를 저었다.

easy: Making something tighter.

ex.en: The tightening of the lid kept the jar closed.
ex.ko: 뚜껑을 꽉 조여서 병이 닫혀 있었다.

easy: Kind and gentle care that shows you love someone.

ex.en: My sick puppy needs lots of TLC.
ex.ko: 아픈 우리 강아지에게는 따뜻한 보살핌이 많이 필요하다.
